entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought a few weeks ago. I'd like to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF778190.
Thank you, Sam. I see your order here, delivered on December 15th. Before we talk about a return, can I ask what the issue is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

It's definitely a preference thing. The band works, but it's just so hard to use. The interface is really confusing, and I guess I just expected more from it. I even went through the user manual a couple of times.
I understand. Sometimes a device just doesn't click with how you want to use it. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I know I'm a bit outside a typical two-week window, but I was hoping we could work something out, maybe a partial credit?
Alright, I've got the policy here. It looks like you're well within the return window. VeloFit offers a 90-day return period for any reason, as long as the item is in its original condition.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. I thought I was going to have an issue. So a full refund is possible?

Absolutely. Since you received it just 25 days ago, we can process that for you right away. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you now with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex, I really appreciate the help.

You're very welcome, Sam. And since you're one of our VIP customers, I've also added a 15% discount code to your account for your next purchase, just in case another one of our products catches your eye. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's perfect. Thanks again for everything!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
